ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Force by Federal Agents
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the use of force by federal agents, including the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti.
questions: What are the protocols for use of force by federal agents?
How often do federal agents use deadly force?
searches: use of force by federal agents
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues with the use of force by federal agents and shed light on the need for greater transparency and accountability.
